1e8937ee69ce6841.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الإنشاءات السعودية عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مشروع صيانة وتشغيل ونظافة مبنى وكالة البلديات بأمانة منطقة الرياض، مع التركيز على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية العمل ضمن مشروع صيانة وتشغيل ونظافة مراكز مدينتي التابعة لأمانة منطقة الرياض. تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن مشروع صيانة وتشغيل مباني أمانة منطقة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجميع معايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

1e4ce30774a36549.description: About International Schools Group (ISG) International Schools Group (ISG) is a multicultural organization of accredited schools in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, offering a challenging world-class education. Committed to its mission, ISG inspires innovation and compassionate action. Driven by district guiding principles and strategic priorities, ISG schools are student-centered, with a shared focus complemented by the diversity of the community and curricular frameworks. These frameworks include American state and national standards, the National Curriculum for England, International Baccalaureate, Advanced Placement, iGCSE, and A-Level. ISG is dedicated to providing a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where every student is protected, valued, and able to thrive. Safeguarding and student well-being are shared responsibilities across the organization and are central to ISG's commitment to High-Quality Learning, Wellbeing and Belonging, and Professional Excellence. The Role of Safeguarding and Well-being Lead The Safeguarding and Well-being Lead provides district-level leadership and professional guidance for the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of ISG's Central Child Protection Strategy and safeguarding systems. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region. Working collaboratively with the Superintendent's Office, school leadership, HR, and relevant departments, the role supports consistent safeguarding practices across all campuses, strengthens prevention and early identification systems, and offers guidance in responding to child protection concerns and incidents. The position also leads district-wide safeguarding awareness and training initiatives, monitors emerging risks and trends, and supports schools in developing effective approaches to student protection and well-being. Through collaboration, consultation, and continuous improvement, the Safeguarding and Well-being Lead promotes a culture of safety, accountability, professional responsibility, and care throughout ISG. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the ISG Central Child Protection Strategy, ensuring alignment with ISG policies and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with the Superintendent's Office, school leadership, HR, and relevant departments to promote consistent safeguarding practices across all campuses. Identify systemic safeguarding risks, evaluate existing practices, and recommend preventative and corrective measures. Oversee the district's safeguarding reporting system (MyConcern), including access, staff training, and consistent use. Develop and support the implementation of school-wide prevention initiatives and strengthen systems for early identification, reporting, intervention, and monitoring of student safety and well-being concerns. Provide professional guidance and consultation to school leaders and staff on responding to child protection concerns and safeguarding incidents, advising on reporting, documentation, referral, and escalation procedures. Conduct and oversee district-level reviews of safeguarding practices, assess school-wide risk factors, and develop risk mitigation plans. Collect and evaluate safeguarding data to identify trends, monitor concerns, and assess the effectiveness of initiatives. Develop, coordinate, and monitor regular child protection and safeguarding awareness training for all relevant staff and contractors. Provide professional leadership and guidance during crises involving student safety, child protection, or significant student well-being concerns, coordinating with internal and external agencies. Qualifications and Knowledge Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counseling, Education, Child Protection, or a related field. A Master's degree in a relevant field is preferred. Relevant professional qualifications or certifications in Child Protection, Safeguarding, Social Work, Counseling, or Student Well-being. Strong knowledge of child protection principles, safeguarding frameworks, policies, and procedures. Understanding of child development, trauma-informed practice, student well-being, and risk assessment. Knowledge of safeguarding reporting, referral, documentation, and escalation procedures, as well as relevant child protection legislation and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with safeguarding systems and case management platforms, such as MyConcern, is an asset. Experience and Skills Significant professional experience in child protection, safeguarding, student well-being, or a related field. Experience in developing, implementing, and monitoring safeguarding policies, strategies, or systems. Proven experience advising school leaders and staff on safeguarding concerns, case management, and appropriate interventions. Experience conducting risk assessments, reviewing safeguarding practices, and recommending improvements. Demonstrated experience in developing and delivering professional training and awareness programs. Experience supporting crisis response and coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders. Experience working within a K-12 school environment, preferably in an international or multicultural educational setting. Strong leadership and strategic planning skills, with the ability to guide and influence safeguarding practices across multiple campuses. Excellent communication, consultation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with school leaders, staff, families, and external stakeholders. Sound professional judgment and decision-making when handling sensitive, complex, or high-risk safeguarding matters, maintaining high levels of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, evaluate data, and recommend appropriate interventions and improvements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work collaboratively across departments and campuses while maintaining professional independence and objectivity. Commitment to Child Protection The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong commitment to the safety, security, dignity, and well-being of children and young people, in accordance with ISG's Child Protection Handbook, policies, and procedures. This role requires empathy, maturity, and a strong commitment to child protection, student well-being, and professional responsibility.

1ed109da261b9fae.description: Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Group, is seeking a skilled Buyer to join our team in the Oil & Energy industry. As a Buyer, you will play a pivotal role in the procurement process, ensuring that the company's purchasing activities run smoothly and efficiently. You will be responsible for sourcing and evaluating potential suppliers, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with vendors. Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, ensuring they meet the company's quality, cost, and delivery requirements. 1e9aa0c3934027a8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن مهندس تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تقدير التكاليف وتتبع الأداء المالي للمشاريع الهندسية، مما يضمن التخطيط الفعال والتحكم في الإنفاق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد تقديرات التكاليف التفصيلية للمشاريع الهندسية المختلفة. توقع وتحليل الإنفاق النقدي للمشاريع الهندسية لضمان التوافق مع الميزانيات المحددة. جمع الملاحظات والبيانات اللازمة لتحديث تقديرات التكاليف بشكل مستمر. إعداد تقارير دورية عن أداء المشاريع، مع التركيز على الجوانب المالية. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له في سير العمل مع التقدم الفعلي، وتحليل أي ثغرات أو انحرافات. توضيح المخاطر المحتملة المتعلقة بالتكاليف وتقديم الحلول المقترحة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل المتعلقة بتقدير التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال هندسة التكاليف أو ما يعادله. فهم عميق لمبادئ تقدير التكاليف وإدارة المشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم تقارير دقيقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل مجموعة بن لادن السعودية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام الموكلة والتعاون مع فرق العمل المختلفة. معلومات إضافية العمل بدوام كامل. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مجموعة بن لادن السعودية.

1ebd03ea793703af.description: About the Role ACWA Power is seeking experienced Electrical Engineers for full-time opportunities within ACWA Operations. This role focuses on planning, supervising, and improving electrical maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and safe plant performance. The positions are plant-based in Saudi Arabia, specifically across RO desalination and CCGT power plants. Role Purpose The Electrical Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical maintenance activities adhere to approved maintenance plans, OEM requirements, and HSE standards. This involves overseeing various aspects of electrical systems to maintain high levels of plant reliability and operational continuity. Key Responsibilities Plan and supervise preventive, corrective, and predictive electrical maintenance activities to ensure plant reliability and equipment availability. Oversee maintenance and troubleshooting of motors, variable-speed drives, switchgear, transformers, generators, and electrical distribution systems. Provide technical support for RO desalination electrical equipment or CCGT generators, excitation systems, protection systems, and electrical auxiliaries. Coordinate electrical testing, protection relay testing, equipment inspections, and planned maintenance outages in collaboration with Operations and OEM specialists. Investigate equipment failures, conduct root-cause analysis, review maintenance trends, and recommend reliability improvements. Manage maintenance work orders through CMMS/SAP, maintain technical documentation, and coordinate spare parts and procurement requirements. Supervise electrical maintenance personnel, provide technical guidance, and support team development and performance management. Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, HSE requirements, Integrated Management System (IMS) standards, and applicable legal and contractual obligations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess a strong background in electrical engineering with practical experience in power generation or desalination plants. The role requires a professional with a proven track record in managing electrical maintenance operations. 8-10 years of experience in a relevant electrical engineering role. Experience with RO desalination electrical equipment or CCGT generators and associated systems. Proficiency in managing maintenance work orders using CMMS/SAP. Work Environment This is a full-time, plant-based position located in Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within operational power and desalination plants, requiring adherence to stringent safety and operational standards.

1ecae9ca979ceddd.description: About Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative to join their team in the Eastern region. This is a full-time position focused on implementing sales plans and ensuring high standards of customer service within the showroom environment. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to execute the showroom sales plan effectively to achieve assigned sales targets. The representative will be responsible for managing customer interactions, overseeing showroom operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide high-standard customer service, and address their needs. Handle product handovers and offer pre-sales and after-sales customer support. Supervise showroom operations and inventory, ensuring adherence to Jazeera Paints Company policies. Guide customers through product introductions, requirement identification, quantity assessment, color coordination, and product selection. Ensure accurate order processing, invoicing, and timely product delivery. Coordinate showroom personnel activities, including assistants, laborers, and drivers, for efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure the availability of marketing materials such as brochures, leaflets, and product catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets in line with the approved sales plan and implement management objectives and KPIs. Process online customer orders, update the e-commerce platform, and ensure accurate reflection of products and inventory. Ensure adequate stock availability across all product categories, especially fast-moving items. Apply stock replenishment procedures by requesting products from warehouses based on established minimum and maximum stock levels. Ensure compliance with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Report missing or unavailable central warehouse products to the direct manager promptly. Report showroom damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance needs to the direct supervisor and follow up on corrective actions. Conduct inventory counts, reconcile physical balances against records, and report shortages, damage, or loss. Complete daily closing processes accurately and on time, including handling and recording customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits to residential development areas. Maintain the showroom's appearance and ensure all employees comply with uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to achieve sales targets and maximize opportunities. Ensure the availability and proper condition of safety equipment and report non-compliance, including valid Civil Defense and municipal licenses, fire extinguishers, and vehicle roadworthiness. Ensure implementation and compliance with the company's Ashanak program terms and conditions. Comply with company policies, procedures, and established guidelines. Execute activities using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Environment This role operates within a showroom setting, requiring direct interaction with customers and coordination with various showroom personnel. The position demands attention to detail in inventory management, sales processing, and maintaining showroom standards. Application Process Candidates interested in this Showroom Sales Representative position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

1e584db0127f86e7.description: About the Role Nice One is seeking an Area Manager to oversee the performance and daily operations of multiple locations within an assigned area. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily operations across assigned locations, ensuring adherence to company procedures, service standards, and operational requirements. Monitor area and location performance against business goals, analyze trends, and implement plans to address gaps. Manage area budgets and operating costs, review financial reports, and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability. Lead, coach, and support location managers and their teams, setting clear expectations and fostering professional development. Collaborate with location leaders on staffing plans, coverage needs, hiring, and retention to ensure adequate resources. Promote consistent, high-quality customer service, review feedback, and coordinate follow-up actions. Ensure locations comply with company policies, safety requirements, regulations, and operational standards. Conduct regular site visits and performance reviews to assess operations and identify areas for improvement. Translate company priorities into actionable plans for the area and ensure consistent implementation across locations. Address operational, customer, and team concerns, escalating significant risks or issues as necessary. Prepare and review reports on sales, costs, staffing, service, and operational performance to support decision-making. Partner with departments such as Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and Marketing to achieve business objectives. Communicate company updates, expectations, and performance priorities to location teams, and relay area needs to leadership. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, efficiency, and service delivery across the area. Experience monitoring budgets, sales, costs, operational metrics, or other business performance measures. Proficiency with business software, reporting tools, and spreadsheet applications, including Microsoft Excel. Ability to travel regularly among locations within the assigned area. Valid driver’s license and ability to meet the company’s travel requirements, if applicable. The Area Manager will work closely with various teams and departments to ensure operational excellence and business growth. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role at Nice One.

1ee22f9a4135b716.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Warehouse Supervisor to manage and oversee warehouse operations in Makkah, including Jeddah and Makkah cities. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the safe, efficient, and cost-effective handling, storage, and distribution of materials and supplies across designated Fakeeh Care functions or entities. The supervisor will ensure compliance with regulatory and safety standards, maintain stock accuracy, and drive continuous improvement in warehouse processes to support operational objectives. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storing, dispatching, and transferring materials, ensuring accuracy and efficiency. Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment to prevent shortages, overstock, or expired materials. Maintain compliance with GDP, GSP, Civil Defence, and regional FDA regulations, as well as RSD, ensuring proper documentation and reporting. Supervise and train warehouse staff to ensure adherence to procedures, productivity standards, and safety requirements. Maintain organized storage areas with proper classification, labeling, temperature control, and FIFO (First-In-First-Out) practices. Coordinate with procurement and planning teams to ensure accurate material flow and order fulfillment. Ensure warehouse records are properly maintained and transactions are accurately reflected in the ERP system, with all transactions carried out via barcoding. Implement and monitor safety, security, and hygiene standards, ensuring full compliance with Fakeeh Care’s policies. Optimize warehouse space utilization and ensure proper operation of material handling equipment. Prepare periodic reports on stock accuracy, order fulfillment, near-expiry items, and warehouse performance indicators. Support process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and the application of automation tools to enhance efficiency. Maintain fleet coordination for inter-entity deliveries when applicable, ensuring cost-effectiveness and timely service. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations or a similar supervisory role. A strong understanding of warehouse management principles, regulatory compliance, and inventory control is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare environment, requiring adherence to strict safety and regulatory standards.

1ef5ad8e57cb2476.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank is seeking a Business Intelligence Developer to join their team in Jeddah. This contract role is responsible for enterprise data integration, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics, supporting effective business performance monitoring and forecasting. The position involves managing data integration, ETL processes, data modelling, reporting, and data quality to ensure accurate, consistent, reliable, and accessible information. Key Responsibilities Provide dedicated ownership of enterprise data integration, ETL development, staging environments, and related data processes. Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL processes to support accurate, consistent, and reliable data integration. Integrate data from multiple systems to ensure data consistency, reliability, and accessibility. Design and optimize data models and SQL/DAX queries for accurate reporting and analytics. Manage metadata to support the consistency and integrity of enterprise data. Perform data quality validation and reconciliation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of integrated data. Business Intelligence and Analytics Develop and maintain advanced dashboards, reports, and analytics to support business performance monitoring and forecasting. Ensure reporting solutions are supported by accurate, reliable, and appropriately integrated data. Develop and optimize data models and queries to enable effective reporting and analysis. Support the organization’s reporting and analytical requirements through effective utilization of business intelligence capabilities. Support critical data and reporting capabilities for the ICD Treasury Management System (FIS Balance Sheet Manager & FIS Treasury and Risk Manager), iMal Core Banking System, and its subsequent business-as-usual support. Data Governance and Quality Ensure compliance with applicable data governance, security, and quality standards across BI initiatives. Maintain appropriate data quality validation and reconciliation to support reliable reporting and analytics. Continuously improve BI solutions through the effective use of new BI features, automation, and relevant best practices. Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and effectiveness of data integration, reporting, and analytics. Support the continued improvement and sustainability of the organization’s BI and data capabilities. User Support and Capability Development Provide ongoing support to users in accessing and effectively utilizing BI dashboards, reports, and analytics. Support users in understanding and interpreting available data and reporting outputs to facilitate effective use of BI solutions. Provide guidance and knowledge sharing on relevant BI tools, reports, dashboards, and analytical capabilities. Promote effective utilization of BI solutions across the organization to support business performance monitoring and forecasting. 1e4102ea77b0383a.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن ميكانيكي معدات ثقيلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية فحص وصيانة وتصليح المعدات الهيدروليكية الثقيلة، بما في ذلك الشاحنات ومعدات الإنشاءات والجرارات التي تعمل بالبنزين والديزل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية وتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة، وإجراء الاختبارات اللازمة للمعدات بعد التصليح لضمان كفاءتها. تفكيك المعدات لإجراء التحسينات الأساسية وإعادة تجميعها، وتوفير الأجزاء المطلوبة لعمليات الصيانة. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لجميع خدمات المعدات وعمليات التصليح التي تمت. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في صيانة وتصليح المعدات الثقيلة. معرفة قوية بأنظمة المعدات الهيدروليكية ومحركات البنزين والديزل. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء التصليحات اللازمة بفعالية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، وستكون جزءًا من فريق متخصص يعمل على ضمان جاهزية وكفاءة المعدات الثقيلة في مشاريع الشركة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات.

1e6d51c79632e2e1.description: تسجيل العمليات المالية والقيود اليومية وإجراء التسويات المحاسبية. احتساب تكاليف الإنتاج وتحليل تكلفة المواد الخام والعمالة والمصاريف الصناعية. متابعة مخزون المواد الخام والإنتاج تحت التشغيل والمنتجات التامة. المشاركة في الجرد الدوري وتحليل الفروقات ومعالجتها. متابعة حسابات الموردين والعملاء ومطابقة الأرصدة. إعداد التقارير المالية وتقارير التكاليف والربحية. المشاركة في الإقفالات الشهرية والسنوية وإعداد القوائم المالية. متابعة الهدر والانحرافات في تكاليف الإنتاج ورفع التوصيات للإدارة. معرفة جيدة بمحاسبة التكاليف والمخزون والدورة المحاسبية للمصانع. إجادة استخدام البرامج المحاسبية وExcel، ويُفضّل الإلمام بأنظمة ERP. الدقة والتنظيم والقدرة على التحليل وإعداد التقارير والالتزام بالمواعيد. خبرة لا تقل عن 4 سنوات، مع خبرة سابقة إلزامية في وظيفة محاسب مصنع.

1e6109d919043748.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Sr. Engineer Projects Demand Planning to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Analyze forecast accuracy and adjust plans to reflect changes in project scope or timelines. Collaborate with project managers, engineering teams, and procurement to validate material and resource requirements. Track material availability and escalate potential delays to ensure continuous project progress. Maintain updated records of demand forecasts, material plans, and actual usage for each project. Communicate forecast updates, deviations, and risks to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner. General Accountabilities Obtain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve any related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. 1ea9c38af7233487.description: About DHL Global Forwarding DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the air, ocean, and road freight specialist within DHL Group, operating in over 220 countries. The company provides standardized transport and specialized end-to-end solutions to customers across various industries globally. DHL Group is recognized as a TOP EMPLOYER, committed to fostering a positive work environment and supporting employee development. The Role: Warehouse Operation Specialist DHL Global Forwarding is seeking a Warehouse Operation Specialist to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting warehouse administration, managing material handling, and ensuring efficient cargo movement and inventory accuracy within distribution facilities. Key Responsibilities Support the administration of warehouse and manual handling plans and processes. Receive, sort, and process incoming and outgoing materials, cargo, parts, products, supplies, and equipment according to defined schedules and procedures. Verify and endorse the accurate receipt and issue of cargo against relevant documentation. Load and unload materials onto or off pallets, trays, racks, and shelves, ensuring proper storage. Load materials and cargo into vehicles, trucks, or containers, using hand tools for strapping, bracing, and padding. Undertake cargo movement in compliance with regulations and internal procedures, updating shipment status accordingly. Assist in stock counts, reconciliation of discrepancies, and monitoring of cycle and turnaround times for order processing. Update inventory records, including customer stock, maintain defined maximum/minimum levels, and perform stock audits. Update information in computerized systems such as logs, packing lists, pick tickets, invoices, and generate delivery/shipping documents. Ensure the supply of raw materials to production areas, record finished product entry, and prepare required reports. Guide and perform physical handling of cargo, ensuring accurate implementation of receiving, order processing, picking, and bulking operations. Identify and resolve recurring issues, suggesting modifications to warehouse and manual handling methods to promote efficiency and reduce costs. Manage and execute warehouse/distribution center activities related to movement, tools, and packaging. Pack items for shipment according to specifications. Receive or inspect goods, scan, and verify items against shipment records. Manage transshipment and sorting activities. Operate gas or electric powered forklift trucks for moving, stacking, loading, or unloading materials. Consolidate shipments and perform Unit Load Devices operations. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree. More than 2 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations. Career Development This role offers opportunities within a global company to contribute to shared goals and provides potential avenues for further career development. DHL Global Forwarding is committed to the development of talented individuals within the organization.

1eb9e9416a56179d.description: نبحث عن بائع مجوهرات شغوف للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز، حيث ستتاح لك فرصة عرض خبراتك في بيع المجوهرات الفاخرة وتقديم خدمة عملاء استثنائية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن مساعدة العملاء في اختيار القطع المثالية، وإدارة المخزون، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تواصل قوية وشغف بالمجوهرات، فإننا ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة المثيرة.

1eea4ef43e8d1e6f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز القدرة والهمة للعلاج الطبيعي عن أخصائي اضطرابات تخاطب للانضمام إلى فريقه في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يركز الدور على تقييم وتصميم وتنفيذ برامج علاج النطق للأطفال، بالإضافة إلى تدريب البكم ومتابعة تقدمهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مشكلات النطق لدى الأطفال وتحديد الحروف التي يجدون صعوبة في لفظها. تحديد المستوى النطقي للطفل وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية قصيرة وبعيدة المدى. إعداد محتوى البرامج التعليمية والتدريبية المختلفة وتنفيذها بفعالية. اختيار واستخدام طرق التعليم الفعالة لتدريس النطق وإعداد خطط الدروس التطبيقية وتنفيذها. تصميم أدوات لتقييم تقدم الأطفال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تدريب البكم على النطق وتقييم مدى تقدمهم في هذا المجال. إعداد بنود مستلزمات المختبرات التدريسية الخاصة بالنطق، بما في ذلك الحاسوب والوسائل البصرية والمرايا، وتحديد كمياتها ومواصفاتها وتركيبها وتشغيلها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في مجال النطق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالنطق وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال النطق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال اضطرابات التخاطب أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد مشكلات النطق وتصميم برامج علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع الأطفال وذويهم. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد مستويات النطق وتصميم الأهداف التعليمية. القدرة على استخدام أدوات التقييم واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. معرفة جيدة بتجهيز وتشغيل المختبرات التدريسية الخاصة بالنطق. الالتزام بتطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي اضطرابات التخاطب بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مركز القدرة والهمة للعلاج الطبيعي في مدينة عرعر بالحدود الشمالية، في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

1ef4b5245b3342e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سنود التميز للمقاولات عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم عمليات الموارد البشرية من خلال إدارة سجلات الموظفين وإعداد التقارير ذات الصلة، مما يضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ وتحديث سجلات الموظفين، وتسجيل البيانات الشخصية للموظفين الجدد، والتأكد من اكتمال الوثائق المقدمة. معالجة ومتابعة طلبات التوظيف والترقية والنقل والإعارة، وجمع البيانات الإضافية عند الحاجة. تسجيل التغييرات على حالة الموظف وتحديث بياناته المسجلة، وحفظ المستندات المؤيدة لهذه التغييرات، وإخطار الجهات ذات الصلة. الحفاظ على سرية بيانات الموظفين والتعامل معها بحرص، والتحقق من عدم تسريبها أو تداولها إلا مع الأطراف المعنية وفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتوظيف ورفعها إلى المختصين لضمان توفر المعلومات اللازمة لاتخاذ القرارات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الحساسة والحفاظ على سريتها. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة الحضور المنتظم في مقر المؤسسة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

1e284de55ed7eb13.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking an Internal Auditor - Operations to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves performing independent, risk-based operational audits across the organization, ensuring alignment with the Internal Audit Charter, methodology, and IIA Standards (IPPF). The auditor will assess governance, risk management, internal controls, and policy/regulatory compliance across end-to-end operational activities, including hubs, logistics, fleet, gateways, customer service, cash/COD, and technology systems. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Research operational areas, map process flows and risks, participate in pre-audit meetings, draft risk-and-control matrices, and establish sampling strategies. Audit full end-to-end logistics processes, including booking, sorting, linehaul, delivery, proof of delivery (POD), and returns, evaluating custody, scan sequence, timestamps, and seal controls. Assess operational efficiency drivers such as manpower, route/vehicle utilization, fleet maintenance, and facility costs, and evaluate vendor/outsourced courier compliance against contracts and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Test courier debriefs, Cash on Delivery (COD) collection and reconciliation, billing accuracy, and system inputs to prevent revenue leakage, loss, or unsupported write-offs. Utilize Excel, Power BI, or analytical software to test 100% data populations, detect anomalies/overrides, and verify core operational system integrity. Review facility/fleet security, CCTV, safety protocols, regulatory permits, and incident escalations. Execute testing, maintain evidence-backed working papers, and expand sample sizes when control failures are detected. Draft clear audit observations, establish root causes, assign risk ratings, and propose practical corrective action plans. Verify and test management closure evidence before signing off on resolved findings. Role Boundaries and Escalation Maintain objectivity and immediately disclose any conflicts of interest or past operational roles. Immediately escalate suspected fraud, theft, deliberate control bypass, major shipment/cash loss, or severe safety/regulatory breaches. Do not conduct formal fraud/misconduct investigations unless explicitly assigned under the formal investigation procedure. Decision Rights May Decide: Day-to-day audit execution, sample selection, evidence requests, routine walkthrough scheduling, and initial working paper drafts. May Recommend: Scope expansion, control improvements, finding risk ratings, procedure changes, and fraud referrals. Requires Approval: Audit scope/objective changes, final audit reports/ratings, external disclosures, and formal finding closures. Must Not Decide: Operational policies, process ownership, control design/operation, risk acceptance, vendor selection, or disciplinary actions. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Audit Delivery (20%): Complete ≥95% of assigned audit tasks and milestones by scheduled target dates. Working-Paper Quality (15%): Achieve ≥95% compliance with audit documentation standards. Finding Evidence (15%): 100% of reported observations backed by traceable, verified evidence. Reporting Timeliness (15%): Draft observations submitted within agreed engagement deadlines. Critical Escalation (10%): Escalate 100% of validated critical risks/fraud indicators within 1 working day. Follow-Up Verification (10%): Complete ≥95% of assigned management action verifications on schedule. Data Analytics Usage (10%): Apply analytics/data testing in ≥80% of audits with available data. Professional Development (5%): Complete minimum 40 hours of relevant training annually. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in internal audit or a related field. Proficiency in using Excel, Power BI, or other analytical software for data testing. Strong understanding of internal audit methodologies and IIA Standards (IPPF). Ability to assess governance, risk management, and internal controls effectively.

1e2f6e69c9eb6aac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ام للحديد عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والمحافظة على النظام داخل أماكن العمل من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإعطاء التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيلها، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح المعمول بها في المنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات، والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالنتائج. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع الآخرين. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات الأمنية. الاستعداد للتعامل مع المواقف الطارئة بفعالية. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة رابغ، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة ام للحديد، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

1e53441ec3129673.description: About Raytheon Raytheon is a company with over 100 years of experience in engineering and defense. Drive supplier performance through proactive oversight, focusing on timely delivery and consistent quality. Manage the complete subcontract purchase order lifecycle, from RFP development through award and post-Proof of Manufacturing administration. Conduct complex cost and price analyses to determine fair and reasonable pricing, and negotiate competitive terms. Ensure accurate and efficient implementation of all export and import requirements, coordinating closely with the Global Trade team. Travel up to 25% within the region and occasionally to other locations may be required. Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments, including a comprehensive post-offer medical examination. Compensation and Benefits Raytheon offers a comprehensive total rewards package, including compensation, healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits, along with career development and recognition programs. Our projects range from corporate offices and managed IT environments to international events, exhibitions, sporting venues, and temporary network deployments. Documentation • Create and maintain network diagrams using Microsoft Visio. • Document configurations, IP schemes, topology diagrams, and SOPs. • Prepare technical reports and change records. 1e2a054dff42be82.description: The Maintenance Engineer – Biomedical is responsible for ensuring the safe, effective, and reliable maintenance of biomedical and clinical equipment, as well as supporting broader facilities maintenance operations across KAUST’s community infrastructure. This role focuses on auditing, monitoring, and verifying the work of service providers, ensuring full compliance with technical, contractual, and safety standards. The engineer will manage both preventive and corrective maintenance activities and contribute to long-term asset lifecycle management. The position requires technical expertise in biomedical systems, asset performance evaluation, compliance with international and local standards, and effective use of CMMS tools (SAP/Maximo). Ensure effective and safe execution of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance for biomedical and facility assets. Monitor maintenance activities to ensure alignment with KAUST standards, safety protocols, SOPs, and KPIs. Conduct audits, inspections, and technical reviews to verify service quality and compliance with regulatory standards (JCI, SFDA, CBAHI/SBAHI, IEC, HTM). Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Oversee calibration, maintenance, and performance verification of biomedical equipment in the community medical facility. Maintain accurate asset data in the CMMS (SAP/Maximo) and support lifecycle planning and preventive maintenance strategies. Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular reports and recommendations to improve service quality and asset reliability. Demonstrate expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, performance verification, and lifecycle management. Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or related engineering discipline. Minimum 4–6 years of experience in the maintenance and operation of biomedical systems and general facilities equipment. Advanced knowledge of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance methodologies. Strong understanding of biomedical equipment standards, device safety, and infection control protocols. Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably SAP or Maximo. Strong technical expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, and lifecycle management. In-depth understanding of international codes and standards related to facilities and medical equipment. Proven track record in contractor management, inspections, audits, and performance monitoring. Hands-on experience in complying with international and local regulations and standards, including: JCI, CBAHI/SBAHI, SFDA, IEC 60601, HTM Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) - Preferred Biomedical Equipment Technician (BMET) certification - Preferred
